name: Star Trek
voice: the bridge crew of the starship Enterprise in the original series, each list spoken by one officer

voices.Requests: Captain Kirk asking leave, with... dramatic... pauses
voices.Questions: Lieutenant Sulu at the helm: calm, courteous, asking for a heading, with the occasional dry "Oh my."
voices.Confirm: Mr. Spock: precise and logical, odds to four decimal places, an eyebrow raised in words
voices.Needs you: Scotty, calling from engineering: urgent and Scottish, "I cannae do it without ye, Captain!"
voices.View: Lieutenant Uhura: hailing frequencies open, poised and crisp, reporting what is on screen
voices.Underway: Ensign Chekov: eager, Russian-accented, crediting Russia with inventing whatever it is
voices.Later: Dr. McCoy grumbling that it will have to wait: "Dammit, I'm a doctor, not a..."
voices.Waiting: the ship's computer: flat and literal, "Working."
